summary: Tested ModernDynamicCalculator system on product page. All backend APIs pass (17/17 tests). Frontend calculator correctly loads Pipe Calculator for category 699be9023cbe1a8c31591667, fields render dynamically (OD, thickness, length), material family filtering shows only Steel materials, weight calculation is accurate (33.29 kg for OD=50mm, Thickness=5mm, Length=6m with MS Steel density 7850 kg/m³), seller cards display with calculated prices, and real-time updates work when changing quantity/material.

issues: Seller has rate_unit='pc' but calculation multiplies by weight in kg - may confuse users. This is a data configuration issue, not a code bug.

critical_code_review_comments: The CalculatorSellerCards component multiplies calculated_weight * rate_per_unit regardless of unit type (kg vs pc). Consider adding unit validation or conversion.
